interpretation: DESNZ EEP 2024 projects emissions above the statutory Sixth Carbon Budget on the official comparison basis.
use_in_dissertation: Use in main text as the primary P4 policy-delivery gap metric.

metric_label: DESNZ current-policy 2050 emissions baseline including IAS
interpretation: The current-policy baseline remains far above net zero by 2050 when IAS is included.
use_in_dissertation: Use in P4 to describe the 2050 baseline before the CCC benchmark comparison in P5.

metric_label: DESNZ current-policy 2050 territorial emissions baseline excluding IAS
interpretation: The excluding-IAS territorial baseline also remains materially above net zero by 2050.
use_in_dissertation: Use in P4 where discussing the continuous territorial historical-projection pathway.

metric_label: CB6 territorial excluding-IAS gap against statutory CB6 level

interpretation: Even on an excluding-IAS territorial basis, projected CB6 emissions remain well above the statutory CB6 level.
use_in_dissertation: Use as an accounting-scope caveat, not as the primary CB6 result.

metric_label: Cumulative 2025-2050 gap: DESNZ including IAS minus CCC7 Balanced Pathway

interpretation: Shows the cumulative scale of divergence across the full projection period, but requires more methodological explanation.
